lines.text: Only use the designated site entrances, access routes, and pedestrian walkways.
Don't enter restricted areas, or another contractor's work area, without permission.
Keep your work area tidy, and never let materials, tools, or waste block an access route.
Don't use your mobile phone while operating plant, or doing any safety-critical task.
Horseplay, fighting, bullying, or working under the influence of alcohol or drugs, will not be tolerated.
Treat everyone with respect: colleagues, subcontractors, clients, and members of the public.
Respect the site, and everyone on it.
